answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with stake-anchored identity: each agent's reputation is bonded to collateral, hard as basalt, so spinning up thousands of fake personas costs real money and gains them nothing. Peers then audit behavior through a mirror of mutual attestation -- agents vouch for one another's real work, and fakes cannot earn genuine vouches. Like a lotus rising from murk, legitimate agents emerge through accumulated honest history that cheap sockpuppets cannot counterfeit.
